# Vendored packages

Atom-era libraries with no maintained npm successor. Vendored from their final
npm releases (see each package.json inside); licenses preserved. One-shot
copies — not built, not updated.

| Package | Version | License | Why vendored |
|---|---|---|---|
| reflux | 6.4.1 | BSD-3-Clause | archived upstream, load-bearing API surface |
| fs-plus | 3.1.1 | MIT | archived upstream, load-bearing API surface |
| event-kit | 2.5.3 | MIT | archived upstream, load-bearing API surface |
| emissary | 1.3.3 | unknown | archived upstream, load-bearing API surface |
